Overview

Santa Tecla is a city in LI with a population of 140,000. An upscale suburb of San Salvador, known for its colonial architecture, restaurants, and cultural venues. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
